title: Review the handoffs, keep the responsibilities
description: A simplified conceptual handoff connects clinical authors, knowledge engineers, and local implementors. Findings return to the responsible reviewers; this is not a reproduction of the published twelve-phase integrated process.

nodes.label: Clinical authors
nodes.body: Source, scope, evidence, recommendation and examples

nodes.label: Knowledge engineers
nodes.body: Explicit concepts, decisions, artifacts and tests

nodes.label: Reviewed feedback
nodes.body: Resolve findings with the clinical, artifact, or local owner; revise linked products.

notes.text: Conceptual summary informed by the integrated process (Matson-Koffman et al., 2023).
Legend: solid arrows = work-product handoffs; dashed arrow = reviewed revisions.
